summary: Navigator settings: collection-doc-cache-path (default $HOME/.cache/ansible-navigator/collection_doc_cache.db), container-engine (--ce: auto tries podman then docker), display-color (--dc, or NO_COLOR), editor-command (--ecmd, default vi +{line_number} {filename}), editor-console (--econ) and execution-environment (--ee, enable or disable using an EE, default True).
questions: How do I make ansible-navigator use docker instead of podman?
How do I run ansible-navigator without an execution environment?
How do I disable colour in ansible-navigator?
Where is the ansible-navigator collection doc cache?

answer_card.title: Key ansible-navigator engine and editor settings
answer_card.answer_md:
| Setting | CLI | Default |
|---|---|---|
| container-engine | `--ce` (`auto`, `podman`, `docker`) | `auto` (podman, then docker) |
| execution-environment | `--ee` (`True`/`False`) | `True` |
| display-color | `--dc` (or `NO_COLOR`) | `True` |
| editor-command | `--ecmd` | `vi +{line_number} {filename}` |
| editor-console | `--econ` | `True` |
| collection-doc-cache-path | `--cdcp` | `$HOME/.cache/ansible-navigator/collection_doc_cache.db` |

Each also has an `ANSIBLE_NAVIGATOR_*` environment variable and a settings-file key.
